patch_description: This redesign uses a staged successive-halving architecture: many diverse deterministic seeds receive a short exploratory optimization budget, are ranked using an exact lower-tail maximin quality key, and only the strongest survivors receive longer refinement and strict polishing. Geometry evaluation is centralized in a reusable state object with batched proposal scoring, reducing duplicated control flow while allowing soft lower-tail exploration early and exact maximin optimization late. Four square corners retain a unit-area convex hull throughout.
